item.title: This Plane Sat for 7 Years: Flying Again
item.description: After sitting grounded for seven years, this aircraft finally gets the opportunity to fly again. Follow the complete process as the plane undergoes detailed inspections, maintenance, engine checks, and test preparations before returning to the skies. The journey highlights the challenges of bringing a long-idle aircraft back into safe flying condition and the excitement of seeing it airborne once more
